mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 1% y/y, it signals a supply-side slowdown that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% y/y, it signals over-exuberance in the housing market that will lead to a demand-side slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST y/y growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp over the past 3 months, signaling a weakening labor market, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending growth slows by more than 2% y/y, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS y/y growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and the consumer price index are both rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are both rising.
